title: AMP Super launches new app
full_text:
AMP Super has launched a new app aimed at helping members better understand their retirement position, plan for the future and manage income.
The new AMP Super app will bring retirement projections, personalised digital advice and pension management together. AMP said the app aims to move beyond basic balance and performance information to give members a clearer view of their retirement outlook.
AMP's latest Retirement Confidence Pulse found just 52% of Australians feel financially confident about retirement, while 58% are concerned their saving could run out.
AMP group executive superannuation and investment Melinda Howes said members were seeking greater clarity about whether their savings would be enough.
"This new digital experience brings together advice, retirement planning and income management in one place, making it easier for members to understand their position, make informed decisions and manage their retirement income with confidence," Howes said.
"Our members want to know whether they're on track for retirement and what practical steps they can take to improve their future financial security."
Eligible members can access projected retirement incomes and estimates of how long their savings may last, alongside personalised digital advice covering areas such and contributions and investments.
The app also includes Lifetime Boost, which may improve future Age Pension outcomes for eligible members who later choose AMP Lifetime Retirement Income.
Members can manage pension payments, view payment schedules, adjust eligible payments and submit withdrawal requests, while functionality, including investment and insurance management and performance tracking.
Howes said AMP's research showed the need to improve retirement confidence despite the strength of Australia's superannuation system.
"Our research shows too many Australians are still uncertain about whether they'll have enough money to retire with confidence," Howes said.
"That is not good enough when you consider the quality of our super system and the savings it's helping Australians build."
The experience follows AMP Super receiving an Epic Retirement Tick, recognising its retirement products, advice, services and digital capabilities. This comes as AMP continues to expand its digital presence, launching North Protect earlier this week to make it easier for eligible clients to consolidate group insurance with their superannuation and investments on North.
The AMP-commissioned survey of 2000 Australians was conducted by Dynata in July 2026.
